issues.description: Program entry symbol exported differs between template and solution: the template file template_repository/pixel.asm declares and exports the symbol 'main' (directive 'global main' at template_repository/pixel.asm:30) and defines the label 'main:' at template_repository/pixel.asm:44. The solution file solution_repository/pixel.asm exports a different global symbol '_start' (directive 'global _start' at solution_repository/pixel.asm:14) while also defining a 'main:' label at solution_repository/pixel.asm:36. This discrepancy in which symbol is made global/exported (main vs _start) can confuse students about which label to implement or modify as the program entry point and about the intended startup/runtime linkage behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the exported entry symbol consistent between template and solution and document the chosen convention. Option A: change the solution to export 'main' (replace 'global _start' with 'global main' and ensure startup behavior remains correct) so both template and solution use 'main'. Option B: change the template to export '_start' (replace 'global main' with 'global _start') and update documentation/comments to explain that students should implement the entry-point expected by the Makefile/build. Also update the README/problem statement to state which symbol is the program entry point so students are not unsure which label to edit.
